title: Apollo 11 'halfway to the moon' window footage faked in Earth orbit
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Apollo 11 'halfway to the moon' window footage faked in Earth orbit, about 1969 at Earth orbit, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's also the uncovered footage that BART has that shows them saying that they're 230,000 miles out or or 30,000 halfway, right?

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, points to footage that he says Bart Sibrel, a filmmaker who questions the moon landings, has uncovered from the 1969 Apollo 11 mission, the first crewed landing on the moon. As Rogan tells it, the footage shows the crew, including Neil Armstrong, saying they are far out in space, about halfway to the moon, while the claim is that they were really still circling close to Earth and faking the view through the window. If true, it would mean at least part of the famous journey was staged.
